calibration.note: Calibration validation deferred for external benchmark; internal Platt scaling verified on held-out validation split.

production_threshold.decision: PRESERVED at 0.50 (no empirical basis to alter without external data)

final_decision_gate.justification: External dataset not provided. Model achieves 88% test accuracy and YuNet achieves 82% full pipeline accuracy, but remains PRELIMINARY until independent multi-generator datasets are ingested.

production_recommendation: Retain MobileNetV2 with Haar Cascade default for production MVP to preserve verified safety guards. Adopt OpenCV YuNet (+26% pipeline accuracy) in next minor version. Ingest independent benchmark images in external_test_data/ to complete external validation.
